title: festuca kingii
intro: Festuca kingii, commonly known as King's fescue, is a species of grass within the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of King's fescue involve soothing and calming effects, making it useful for treating anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
